newsitem.title: USA: Travelers/Aetna names Long vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Travelers/Aetna names Long vice chairman.

text.p: Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp said Tuesday that it has hired Stanton Long as vice chairman, effective immediately.
Long was most recently president of AIGCS, a subsidiary of American International Group, the company said.
His post is newly created, said company spokesman Keith Anderson.
Travelers/Aetna, a member of Travelers Group Inc, was formed in April with the merger of the property-casualty operations of Travelers and Aetna Life and Casualty Co.
